name: web_search
description: Search the web for the operator. Tries the real keyboard in Chrome first, then types into the page in the browser, then falls back to the search API.

strategies.name: desktop_keyboard
strategies.description: Real cursor and keyboard: focus Chrome, type the search address into the address bar, press Enter, then read the screen (OCR) to confirm results are visible.

steps.note: start Chrome if it is not open (no-op when it is)
type the search address with the keyboard
confirm the query words are on screen

strategies.name: browser_typing
strategies.description: Open the search engine in the managed browser, type the query into its search box, press Enter and read the results page.

steps.note: type into the search box and submit

strategies.name: search_api
strategies.description: Keyless search API (Tavily, Serper, SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, Jina — whichever is configured). No browser needed.
